name: JT1 Electric Inc.
description: An electrical contractor serving Pocono Lake and the surrounding Poconos area.

hero.headline: JT1 Electric Inc.
hero.sub: Wiring, panel upgrades, and electrical repair for homes and small businesses in the Poconos.

items: Wiring for renovations and new construction
Troubleshooting and repair for outlets, switches, and fixtures
Serving Pocono Lake and the surrounding Poconos area
Licensed electrical work, residential and light commercial
Panel and wiring work scoped and quoted up front
Troubleshooting calls handled without unnecessary upselling

story.heading: About
paragraphs: JT1 Electric handles everything from a single tripped breaker to a full panel upgrade for homes across the Poconos.
The shop’s focus stays on getting the wiring right the first time, since a callback in this area means a long drive.

items: A service call starts with a diagnosis before any repair is quoted.
Panel upgrades come with an inspection of the existing wiring first.
New construction wiring is coordinated with the builder’s timeline.

feature.heading: Panel upgrades done right the first time
feature.text: An outdated panel is both a safety issue and a bottleneck for anything added to the house later -- it gets checked properly before the upgrade.

spotlight.heading: Built for the Poconos service area
spotlight.text: Covering a wide rural area means being ready to travel for both routine wiring and urgent repairs.
